title: Cokernels and epimorphisms read off from exactness in an abelian category
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]; exactness is that of [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. (a) If $X\xrightarrow{h}Y\xrightarrow{e}Z$ is a complex exact at $Y$ and $e$ is an epimorphism, then $e$ is a cokernel of $h$: every $\varphi:Y\to W$ with $\varphi\circ h=0$ factors as $\varphi=\psi\circ e$ for a unique $\psi:Z\to W$. (b) If $X\xrightarrow{e}Y\xrightarrow{k}Z$ is a complex exact at $Y$ and $k=0$, then $e$ is an epimorphism. (c) If $m:X\to Y$ is a monomorphism and $\pi:Y\to Z$ is a cokernel of $m$, then $0\to X\xrightarrow{m}Y\xrightarrow{\pi}Z\to0$ is a short exact sequence. (d) $\mathcal A$ has pushouts: for morphisms $p:A\to B$, $q:A\to I$ there are an object $Q$ and $j:B\to Q$, $k:I\to Q$ with $j\circ p=k\circ q$, such that any $j':B\to W$, $k':I\to W$ with $j'\circ p=k'\circ q$ factor uniquely through $(j,k)$.
